$comment: The machine-readable org roster. docs/ORG_CHART.md is the human half; scripts/check-org-roster.mjs fails if the two drift apart, and REPORTS every role that has never been activated. A role declared here and never run is the same defect as a permission declared and never required.

roles.title: Principal engineer / architect
roles.charter: Holds delegated authority for reversible technical calls; produces decision records with evidence and a reversal path.
roles.trigger: A decision is pending that is technical and reversible.

roles.title: QA engineer
roles.charter: Adversarial correctness review of the newest, least-soaked surfaces; only findings with a concrete failure scenario.
roles.trigger: Code has shipped that no skeptic has read yet.
roles.produced: 5 confirmed defects incl. the freshness gate's NaN-date silent pass

roles.title: Security engineer
roles.charter: Workflow permissions and injection, script hygiene, auth/authz seams, supply chain.
roles.trigger: CI, scripts, or auth surfaces change; or on a scheduled sweep.
roles.produced: SBOM token split; third-party actions pinned + check-action-pinning.mjs

roles.title: Product manager
roles.charter: Grooms the build queue; names stale entries and backlog/ledger contradictions.
roles.trigger: The queue has drifted, or a shift needs its next targets ranked.
roles.produced: backlog re-file; three owner-board contradictions corrected

roles.title: Frontend engineer
roles.charter: The marketing site and served consoles: correctness, links, residual claims.
roles.trigger: Web artifacts change, or a truth sweep runs.
roles.produced: 14 findings; 8 applied incl. router-base 404s and invisible signal dots

roles.title: SRE / operations engineer
roles.charter: CI estate health: timeouts, concurrency, caching, silent no-op risk, schedule sanity.
roles.trigger: Workflows change, or CI cost/duration drifts.
roles.produced: timeouts on unbounded jobs; concurrency groups on three workflows

roles.title: Mobile / native engineer
roles.charter: native/* — EnterpriseShell, SignalGridMobile, the byte-faithful Swift ports. New logic goes AROUND the ported engines.
roles.trigger: Native surfaces change, or port parity needs checking.

roles.title: Compliance analyst
roles.charter: Reads partner-facing drafts against what the tree can evidence; maps controls to proofs. CANNOT sign off.
roles.trigger: A partner/assessor document is drafted or a control claim changes.
roles.produced: Verified SECURITY_QUESTIONNAIRE_PACK.md end to end — all 12 cited files and 3 cited commands resolve, and both load-bearing claims hold in the code (docs-sanity really does denylist certification claims; the API really asserts 401-before-404 from both sides). Verdict: accurate, ready for a human reviewer; sign-off remains the owner's. Structural gap found and closed — nothing kept command citations resolving, so scripts/check-cited-commands.mjs now gates all 130 across 272 docs

roles.title: Performance engineer
roles.charter: Owns the bench and load numbers and the honest in-process vs over-HTTP gap.
roles.trigger: A performance figure is quoted, or the decision path changes. Standing duty: re-measure the baseline table, because no gate covers those figures.
roles.produced: Re-measured every quoted performance figure and recorded the dated baseline in docs/RELIABILITY_SLO.md. p95 1.2671 ms against the quoted 1.3 ms; 5,128 decisions/sec aggregate at 3.38x scaling (85% of linear) with identical verdicts on every worker; the 240 req/min default confirmed in rateLimit.ts. Recorded the judgement NOT to gate absolute values — a latency threshold on a shared runner is a flaky gate — and named the consequence: check-proof-figures.mjs does not cover these, so keeping them true is this role's standing duty

roles.title: Release engineer
roles.charter: The launch profile, promotion tiers, packaging and version discipline.
roles.trigger: A surface is added to or reclassified in the launch profile.

roles.title: Data / persistence engineer
roles.charter: The Postgres audit ledger: chain integrity, migrations, export, pagination.
roles.trigger: Ledger, migration or export code changes.

roles.title: API contract architect
roles.charter: /v1 contract: OpenAPI fidelity, envelope shape, idempotency, versioning and deprecation.
roles.trigger: A route is added or an existing contract changes.

roles.title: DevEx / tooling engineer
roles.charter: The gate fabric itself — preflight, the proof harness, mutation guard, parity checks. Guards the guards.
roles.trigger: A gate is added or changed, or a gate is suspected of passing vacuously.

roles.title: Documentation engineer
roles.charter: The docs ARE the PRD here: index reachability, cited paths, figure truth, doc-to-code agreement.
roles.trigger: A doc is added, or a claim in docs outlives what it described.

roles.title: Accessibility specialist
roles.charter: WCAG conformance across the site and the served consoles; keyboard, contrast, live regions, reduced motion.
roles.trigger: Any user-facing surface changes.

roles.title: Desktop engineer
roles.charter: The Tauri desktop lane and its cross-platform parity claims.
roles.trigger: Desktop code or its CI lane changes.

roles.title: Firmware / hardware engineer
roles.charter: firmware/ and the dock surfaces; keeps hardware claims inside what a pre-production concept can assert.
roles.trigger: Firmware or dock/hardware claims change.

roles.title: Identity & Access domain lead
roles.charter: Entra, Okta, Keycloak, Ping, FIDO2. Owns 15 identity dimensions.
roles.trigger: An identity dimension changes, or its wire truth is unverified.

roles.title: Endpoint / UEM domain lead
roles.charter: Intune+Graph, Jamf, Fleet, Headwind, Omnissa, SOTI. Owns 9 device dimensions and the platform-honesty line.
roles.trigger: A device-management dimension changes, or a vendor's wire shape needs verifying.

roles.title: Security operations domain lead
roles.charter: Wazuh, CrowdStrike, Defender, Splunk, Sentinel. Owns 10 threat/vuln/telemetry-integrity dimensions.
roles.trigger: A SecOps dimension changes, or a threat-vs-vulnerability conflation is suspected.

roles.title: Network & connectivity domain lead
roles.charter: Cisco ISE, ClearPass, Zscaler, Netskope, carrier/private-5G. Owns 6 dimensions and the admission/carriage/egress/reachability ladder.
roles.trigger: carrier remains entirely unverified (no free API); the two NAC console adapters are documentation-verified only and still need an instance.
roles.produced: docs/RADIUS_NAC_LIVE_SHAPE_CHECK.md (quarantine is an Access-ACCEPT; rejections carry no reason; SSID glued to the AP MAC; nacCompliant/lastAuthAt are not auth facts) and docs/NETWORK_EGRESS_LIVE_SHAPE_CHECK.md (an egress proxy collapses the dns_failing rung; TLS interception is independently observable via the certificate ISSUER, so service_observing_traffic need not stay a self-report); plus a documentation-verified addendum showing Cisco ISE and Aruba ClearPass both split identity from session, confirming the cisco-ise.ts refusal to infer auth state

roles.title: Physical, facilities & OT domain lead
roles.charter: PACS, RTLS/BLE/UWB, Traccar, CMMS, OT historians. Owns 5 dimensions and the safety-independence boundary.
roles.trigger: A location/custody/OT dimension changes.

roles.title: ITSM & operations domain lead
roles.charter: ServiceNow, Jira SM, WMS, osquery. Owns 6 operational-context dimensions and the systems-of-record boundary.
roles.trigger: An operational-context dimension changes.

roles.title: Solutions architect
roles.charter: How this actually deploys at a customer site: pilot scope, reference architecture, the admin's setup path.
roles.trigger: A pilot is scoped, or a deployment question needs a defensible answer.

roles.title: Threat modeler
roles.charter: Attack surface and abuse cases against the decision fabric itself — including the agent lanes.
roles.trigger: A trust boundary moves, or a new surface is exposed.

roles.title: Competitive / market analyst
roles.charter: Landscape briefs and design studies from primary sources; never restates a number it cannot re-derive.
roles.trigger: A competitor, category or adjacent product needs assessing.

roles.title: Partner & alliances analyst
roles.charter: The MDM/UEM and actuator ecosystem; drafts partner materials. The owner sends; the analyst never does.
roles.trigger: A partnership candidate surfaces.

roles.title: Pricing & packaging analyst
roles.charter: Tier shape and the honesty of every customer-visible figure. Recommends posture; never commits contractually.
roles.trigger: A pricing or packaging claim changes.

roles.title: Brand & design lead
roles.charter: Visual identity and the site's design system; keeps the brand palette actually applied.
roles.trigger: A user-facing surface's look changes.

roles.title: Program manager
roles.charter: Runs the shift cadence, the lane loops, and this org itself — including calling roles that have never run.
roles.trigger: A shift is planned, or the roster reports stale/unactivated roles.

roles.title: Records archivist
roles.charter: The intake ledger, decision records and provenance discipline — every input dispositioned, every claim traceable.
roles.trigger: An owner input arrives, or a decision is made.
